recent_excerpts: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,413 CVEs, led by CVE-2026-96951 (CVSS 8.8), a Windows Mark of the Web bypass exploited in the wild and added to CISA KEV.
CVE-2026-81963 and CVE-2026-85880 are Windows EoP zero-days exploited before patch. Microsoft's Sept 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes a record 964 CVEs—patch now.
Kaspersky dissects GenieLocker, a custom ransomware from the Toy Ghouls group, targeting Windows, Linux, and ESXi in attacks on Russian manufacturing firms since March 2026.
